title: Market claims evidence register in docs/rbpc/BUSINESS_PLAN_DRAFT.md and docs/rbpc/

implementation_summary.goal: Establish a market claims evidence register categorizing every market claim with dates, methodology, sample size, and truth tier (OBSERVED / HYPOTHESIS / FORECAST), with export facilities for pitch reviews.

truth_tier_system.OBSERVED: Factually verified operational actual, executed contract, or empirical government statistic.
truth_tier_system.HYPOTHESIS: Model assumption, user survey finding, or tested usability hypothesis pending longitudinal proof.
truth_tier_system.FORECAST: Forward-looking market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM) or financial projection for business planning.

negative_abuse_guardrail.rule: Unverified external benchmarks or TAM/SAM/SOM forward projections cannot be displayed as actual LƯU NIÊN operational KPIs. Operational KPIs must be strictly OBSERVED actuals.
negative_abuse_guardrail.enforcement: MarketClaimEvidence.validate_integrity() and MarketClaimsEvidenceRegister.validate_claim_against_operational_kpi() fail closed with ValueError if any non-OBSERVED or market sizing claim is marked as operational KPI.

pitch_review_export.json_export: Structured JSON containing metadata, summary counts, and full claim details.
pitch_review_export.markdown_export: Formatted GitHub-flavored Markdown table suitable for pitch decks and investor due diligence.
